integrity: The proof is analytical, with independently reproducible finite rational diagnostics in a standard-library checker. Self-review is not independent scientific validation. The no-equivalent-source search does not establish absolute publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the unit-edge shortest-path metric of \(K_{m,2,\ldots,2}\), with \(m\ge2\) and \(t\ge1\), and exact optimal Hilbert distortion; does not solve all finite spherical line-code dimensions or arbitrary complete multipartite profiles.
title: Optimal multipartite embeddings reduce exactly to spherical line codes
